title: No customer support and unable to activate premium
body:
I have waited a week posting this review to see if the customer support will answer my email but they did not.

 I paid for the lifetime subscription but despite reinstalling the app, clicking on upgrade several times, the app never activates the full version despite that I paid for it. 

Even more annoying is that it keeps asking for me going premium and when I do, it says I'm already premium even though the app stays in basic mode. So the app is worthless unless they fix this issue. If they don't fix this soon I'll ask for a refund and notify Apple.

title: I wish it was smarter
body:
When I set it up for a task every morning. And to give me a notification for it to be done. And when I do it and check it off as done that morning, before the time for the notification, I want it to then not send me a notification on the set time. 

I want to be able to customise. Especially for the weekly tasks. I find it hard to see if if I’ve checked the task as done that day or just some time that week. 

I also wish for there to be added a monthly task. Or even longer. More freedom to customise.

title: Best app of its kind in my opinion
body:
I’ve been looking for an app like this for ages and this one meets 99% of my hopes. It has incredible simplicity and allows you to see your progress whether you are building or ending a habit. I love that it has weekly and monthly totals so that you feel motivated even if you didn’t meet your target now and then. 

The visuals are great and its user friendly. I wasn’t going to upgrade to full version but I quickly saw it was going to be worth it. 

I really hope they manage to maintain the current simplicity and ‘at-a-glance’ usability as they continue to grow the app’s potential.
